name: Digital Broker Twin (DBT)
objective: Replay and paper paths consume identical broker physics as live MT5 without modifying signal/risk/exit logic
design_principle: Replace execution adapter internals with DBT; keep IOrderExecutor interface stable

modules.name: BrokerTwinEngine
modules.responsibility: Orchestrate order lifecycle: accept → validate → queue → fill → report

modules.name: MarketDataFeed
modules.responsibility: Bid/ask tick stream or synthetic from candles+ticks

modules.name: LiquidityBook
modules.responsibility: Approximate depth curve; max fillable lot

modules.name: LatencySimulator
modules.responsibility: Sample delay; advance tick stream to t+Δ; price at arrival

modules.name: BrokerRules
modules.responsibility: stops_level freeze_level digits volume_min/step max deviation

modules.name: MarginEngine
modules.responsibility: Margin calc, margin call, stop-out simulation

modules.name: ExecutionTelemetry
modules.responsibility: TCA metrics, execution score, rejection log

interfaces.IOrderExecutor: Existing port — DBT implements shadow or replaces Mt5ExecutionAdapter paper branch

data_flow: FillReport → PaperTradeRecorder / journal (prices only, no logic change)

validation_strategy.unit: Each engine deterministic with fixed seed + golden fixtures
validation_strategy.parity: DBT paper vs live fill log MAE on spread/slip (Phase 30D)
validation_strategy.replay: 489 Phase29B trades — PF within ±5% of calibrated target
validation_strategy.regression: TRADINGBOT_SIGNAL_FILTER=OFF byte-identical signals; only fills differ
validation_strategy.stress: Phase30A scenario matrix re-run under DBT

integration_modes.replay: Bar loop feeds MarketSnapshot; DBT replaces instant fill in replay portfolio open
integration_modes.paper: Mt5ExecutionAdapter paper branch delegates to DBT instead of PaperBroker
integration_modes.live_shadow: Live sends real order; DBT simulates parallel; log divergence
integration_modes.live: Future Phase 31+ — optional not in 30C scope
